footer.about: Online work offers published by i-SOA DigiLab for invited freelancers.
footer.notice: i-SOA WorkHub does not guarantee work or income. You never pay to take part. Payments are made in USDT after your work is approved.

home.hero_title: Work online with i-SOA DigiLab. Get paid in USDT.
home.hero_sub: We publish design, development and social-media missions. You get an invitation by email, accept the mission, deliver, and receive your share in crypto.
home.step1_text: We email you a private link to a mission.
home.step2_text: Open the link, check the reward, and accept it.
home.step3_text: Send us the link to your finished work.
home.step4_text: After approval, your share is sent to your crypto wallet.
home.split_text: For each mission: 50% i-SOA DigiLab, 40% to the freelancer, 10% fees. You always see your exact amount before you accept.
home.trust_text: We never ask you for money. Learn how to spot scams and keep your wallet safe.

safety.title: Trust & Safety
safety.intro: Your safety matters. Follow these rules.
safety.s1: i-SOA WorkHub never asks you to pay to get or keep a mission.
safety.s2: Only use the private link sent from our official email. Do not share it.
safety.s3: Never share your wallet seed phrase or private key with anyone. We only need your public address.
safety.s4: Double-check your wallet address and network: crypto payments cannot be reversed.
safety.s5: Be careful with anyone promising guaranteed income. We do not.
